name: Original Flamingo rigid-node fighter
authorship: Project-authored original low-poly geometry created through Blender MCP. No commercial game character, ROM, downloaded model, photograph or texture was used in these GLBs.
copyPolicy: Only these five explicitly allowlisted GLBs were copied byte-for-byte. Operational scripts, MCP responses, logs and private paths are not runtime payload.
attachmentRule: Accessories contain target-local offsets. Parent their loaded scene to the named head or wing without preserving world transforms.
rendering: The renderer instantiates the original seven-node hierarchy; creates four independent feather palettes; attaches original gloves, headband or chef hat; and supplies procedural small-angle poses. No Nintendo image, logo, model or sound is packaged.
limits: Rigid joints are not a deforming skeletal rig and have no knee IK. CPU geometry, hashes, transforms and projection tests do not establish browser/GPU appearance or performance. Genre inspiration does not imply Nintendo affiliation.
